name: Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 14/32, 3,040 m × 45 m; 3,370 m × 45 m for take-off from runway 14 when the starter extension is used (TORA 3,370 m with starter extension) (AIP footnote: "** These figures include the Starter Extension.")

hours.v: air traffic services H24; aerodrome administration office Mon-Fri 04:45-12:00 UTC (08:45-16:00 local), closed weekends and holidays

fuel.quote: Jet A1, Turbo Oil 2380, ASTO 390, Skydrol 500B

notes: Sources: DCA Mauritius AIP AD 2-FIMP page dated 21 APR 22 (AMDT 01/22) and the DCA eAIP package labelled 12_11_2024_updated (AD 2 FIMP page, no effective date shown on the page); both agree on runway and fuel. A newer DCA eAIP edition dated 2025-05-15 (Non-AIRAC AMDT 1-25) exists but could not be opened: https://civil-aviation.govmu.org/eAIP/eAIPMauritius/final/2025-05-15/html/cover-en-GB.html (site error). Customs and immigration are given as "HO" (ICAO: service available to meet operational requirements), not as fixed hours, so customs was not recorded. No night curfew, PPR or slot rule appears in the AD 2 text read, but the AIP does not say explicitly that there is none, so curfew is left out. Quotes come from a summarising fetch tool and may need checking against the PDF. Local time is UTC+4 (no DST).
